description: Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/relocation_comparison_draft.xlsx. This spreadsheet compares cost of living between Denver (current location) and Austin (job offer location). Complete the missing formulas: (1) In cell D15, create =SUM(D5:D13) for Denver total monthly costs. (2) In cell E15, create =SUM(E5:E13) for Austin total. (3) In cell F15, calculate the difference =E15-D15. (4) In cell G15, calculate percentage difference =(E15-D15)/D15. (5) In cell D17, calculate annual Denver costs =D15*12. (6) In cell E17, calculate annual Austin costs =E15*12. (7) In cell E25, calculate break-even salary =D20*(E15/D15). (8) In cell E26, calculate real salary increase =E21-E25. Apply currency formatting to dollar amounts and percentage formatting to G15. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
